title: storageKey persists arrangement on some components and not others
foundBy: agents building two consumer apps against 0.2.0, relayed by the repository owner

evidence.verified: `npx vitest run --project jsdom src/components/storageKey.test.tsx`: 3 tests pass with `getItem` and `setItem` both throwing `QuotaExceededError`. `useTheme` still switches to dark, `ThemeToggle`'s radio variant still sets `data-theme="dark"`, and `SplitPane` still renders both panes. Removing `useTheme`'s write guard fails the first with that error, and removing `SplitPane`'s read guard fails the third. `npm run ci` exits 0.

details:
`SplitPane` takes a `storageKey` and persists its width. `useTheme` and `ThemeToggle` take one too. `Panel`, `Tree` and `MarkdownViewer` have no equivalent, so every consumer that wants panel open state, tree expansion or viewer panes to survive a reload writes its own localStorage code, each with its own try and catch for private mode and quota errors.

The proposal is to adopt `storageKey` as a kit-wide convention for user-arrangement state, with storage failures degrading to in-memory rather than throwing.

This is filed low because each component can adopt it independently and nothing is broken today. It is worth deciding once so the components that adopt it agree on the name and the failure behaviour.

notes.text: Confirmed: storageKey appears on src/lib/useTheme.ts, src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx and src/components/SplitPane.tsx, and on no other component.

The repository owner adopted the stopping rule this branch had proposed and never had confirmed: fix the defects a consumer would hit, record everything else, and decide the rest at 0.3.0. This record is one of the six that wait, because each adds or changes a public prop, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` asks that the design be settled before the code is written.

They are one conversation rather than six, and this is the order they unlock in: CUI-014 first, because whether navigation is a supported use decides CUI-011; then CUI-012, because the `storageKey` convention decides CUI-010; then CUI-009 and CUI-011 together, which are both about sizing to content; and CUI-013 last, which stands alone. The Tooltip and MarkdownMinimap changes that already landed belong in the same conversation.

This is the one to answer first of the pair with CUI-010, because the name and the storage-failure behaviour bind every component that adopts them afterwards.

Closed as a decision rather than a migration, which is what this record asked for. Convention 7.3 already named the prop and the two calls. What it left open, and what a component adopting it has to agree on, was which state belongs there and what a storage failure means. Both are now written down.

Both were already true of the three components that take a `storageKey`, and nothing checked either, which is the class this branch exists to close. A test now drives all three against storage that throws.

`Panel`, `Tree` and `MarkdownViewer` still do not take one. Adopting it in each is separate work, and the convention no longer has to be settled first.
